patch_description: This crossover preserves the inspiration program’s three-stage hypercube entanglement and alternating noncommuting mixers while adopting the current program’s aggressive parameter sharing. Preparation, bridge, and decoding rotations are shared globally; only the central RX mixer retains the two hypercube color channels needed to break an overly restrictive global symmetry. The block therefore uses five parameters instead of seven, yielding 32 total trainable parameters including readout versus 44 for the inspiration ansatz. It retains full-register correlation transport, avoids measurement-invisible terminal RZ gates, and should improve parameter efficiency and generalization without reducing the known useful entangling structure.
